title: Contact-conditioned factorized reach/lift/carry encoder
coverage_gap: The support pairs object and goal x signs. Reaching for the object and transporting toward the goal therefore do not require disentangling these factors in support. The same end-effector height can also occur during descent and ascent, so a height-only stage prior could confuse them. This model tests a learned, causal behavioral-regime factorization rather than relying on a single unstructured state embedding.
reusable_regularity: Separate reach, lift and carry MLPs represent distinct relations. Reach sees no goal coordinates; lift sees contact motion and wall clearance but no goal coordinates; carry sees independent goal-hand/object/wall edges. A small learned gate uses aperture, hand-object separation, vertical/y motion, object/hand/goal height, wall-relative y and top clearance, plus horizontal goal distance. It sees no signed absolute object_x or goal_x. Its soft probabilities modulate separate 32-dimensional branches, with a 0.05 floor preserving access when uncertain. Gates are predictions from observations, never teacher-forced stages. The common single four-action DP consumes the 142-dimensional per-observation representation. This is not an expert controller or a mixture of multiple DPs.
dependencies_preserved: The reach relation and the goal-object relation have separate direct gated linear skips in addition to learned encoders. The positive gate floor avoids discarding goal or grasp geometry based on a predicted stage.

Absolute hand and wall centers preserve robot/world position; both object xyzw quaternions, current/previous aperture and native-previous hand/object increments preserve pose and temporal information.
Wall center, all half-sizes, signed six-face distances for hand/object and top clearances preserve the finite obstacle. Goal z remains present both in carry relations and the gate.
World axes and fixed gripper orientation are retained. No rotation/translation symmetry is imposed on the robot. Only declared absent object2 fields are unused.
Branch and gate parameters are all registered in build_modules and participate in the same joint optimizer loss as the untouched common U-Net.

evidence_refs.use: Only current D10 support; no feedback or other task data.
Missing cross-sign cells, causal history, fixed world-axis action/gripper semantics and available obstacle geometry.
LL/HH balance and small support goal-object x offsets motivate factor separation, not ID-specific behavior.
Actual raised grasp before crossing inspected.
Actual carry outcome near the elevated goal inspected.
Another actual pre-lift interaction posture inspected.
Another actual raised transport posture with a lower goal inspected.
Aperture falls during grasp, hand-object offset stabilizes, action z=1/y=0 lift transitions to z=0/y=1 transport. These motivate training-only behavioral phase labels and causal velocity inputs.
Gripper aperture decreases during descent while object remains near table height, so height alone is not a reliable grasp state.
Separate training-only target and loss hooks, per-start valid masks, no labels in causal conditioning or deployment.

expected_failure_signature: If the phase gate learns demonstration timing indirectly rather than contact, a stalled closure or atypical aperture will trigger lift too early or leave the policy oscillating between reach and lift.
If phase isolation solves reaching but not goal extrapolation, C/E should show intact grasp and vertical lift yet systematic lateral transport undershoot. No claimed measurements are available.

The three regimes are coarse behavioral pseudo-labels, not contact truth; transitions or simultaneous lateral/vertical recovery actions may be assigned poorly. A low phase classification loss need not imply task success.
Goal height is visible but the support largely lifts high before transport. Low-goal arrivals may retain an unnecessarily high lift or descend at the wrong wall-relative y.

required_runtime_fields.source: causal_context.raw_history [B,2,45] from shared state observations. No stateful phase counter or time input.
required_runtime_fields.scaling: Relations/clearance use 0.1 m; native-previous position increments use 0.01 m; world hand/wall centers use 0.5 m. No support variance amplification of goal-object x.
required_runtime_fields.action_frame: Identity encode/decode of native world delta xyz and independent gripper. Scale is 0.01 m for xyz, gripper controls [g,-g], native orientation remains fixed. Only host clips after decoding and executes four of sixteen.

training_only_targets.name: phase_labels
training_only_targets.source_fields: For each D_N window start t and its causal-history partner max(0,t-1): support actions[step,1:3] and obs[step,5:7], wall center[40:42], wall half-size[43:45].
training_only_targets.definition: Label 1 when native action_z>0.5 and abs(action_y)<0.2; otherwise label 2 when object_z exceeds wall top or object_y exceeds far wall face; otherwise label 0. These are coarse lift/carry/reach pseudo-labels derived from the supplied support, not oracle contact/success labels.
training_only_targets.loss: 0.1 times cross entropy on the two causal-history stage logits. Each window contributes mask[:,0] to each of its two labels; denominator is max(1,2*sum(mask[:,0])). This is separate from the unchanged weight-1 action epsilon MSE with denominator mask.sum()*4.
training_only_targets.inference_isolation: Only predicted logits/probabilities computed in condition are used in the action DP. No true stage label is supplied to condition, denoise or action mappings. Labels are not stored in deployment state.

support_fit: No nonlearned fitted statistics. training_targets constructs labels only for the supplied exact D_N windows.
change_summary: Initial distinct scientific design: three learned causal relation branches plus an auxiliary-supervised causal gate, positive gating floor and raw geometric skip features. No joint future diffusion channels, no action remapping. Not derived from performance feedback. No structural repairs as authored.
